spanish: Tres cálices almendrados en la caña la una, botón y flor, y tres cálices almendrados en la caña la una, botón y flor; así a las seis cañas las salientes desde el candelabro.
grammarChanges: H3730 (h02025033006, h02025033013): replaced calque 'manzana', which falsely licenses the fruit apple, with 'botón', the knob/capital sense the noun actually carries; applied to both occurrences.

H4501 (h02025033020): translated the common noun 'la menorá' as 'el candelabro' instead of leaving the non-name lemma untranslated; adjusted the article from feminine to masculine to agree with 'candelabro'.
